findings.text: Provides construction of executable image description from a memory buffer, accepting only recognized executable kinds and refusing interpreter dependent inputs, releasing partial state when checks fail.
Provides probing of a candidate buffer for loadability, building temporary description, discarding it, then confirming processor compatibility.
Provides loading of loadable extents from a validated description into staged buffers, reporting back the smallest destination observed.
Provides release of allocated header table storage and clearing of the associated description object.
Provides default selection of an image handler by trying registered loaders in order until one accepts the buffer.
Provides default post load cleanup that delegates when a handler supplies it and otherwise reports success.
Provides verification of a kernel blob against secondary keys with fallback to platform keys when the first attempt reports a missing key and that fallback is enabled.
Provides enabling of mandatory signature enforcement for subsequently validated images.
Provides bidirectional transfer of a fixed sized value between caller memory and a named purgatory symbol after existence, size and section checks.

System entry for installing or removing a kernel image from file descriptors, handling default and crash destinations, permission and flag screening, serialized preparation, segment staging, integrity recording, post actions and atomic publication.

Header acceptance requires plausible entry sizes when counts are positive, current version markers in both identification and header fields, plus overflow free containment of both header tables within the supplied buffer length.

Header parsing demands sufficient input length, correct magic, supported width and byte order, expected overall header size, endian adjusted field extraction with width specific handling of addresses and offsets, and final sanity approval, signaling distinct failures for malformed versus unknown width inputs.
Segment descriptor acceptance requires file backed range to lie inside the input without address wrap and destination range to avoid wrap.
Program header collection reserves zeroed storage sized by declared count and abandons the whole collection with release when any single entry fails to parse.
Buffer interpretation first decodes the header, records references to the raw bytes and decoded header, then conditionally decodes the program table only when offset and count indicate its presence.
Image construction additionally requires presence of a program table and absence of any interpreter requesting entry, treating violations as non executable inputs with cleanup.
Staging considers only loadable entries and limits copied extent to the smaller of file backed and memory resident sizes.
Signature outcome is fatal under enforcement, may be denied when measurement appraisal succeeds while the platform restricts this operation, and is otherwise tolerated with diagnostic output.

Preparation reads the kernel object under a size ceiling, probes its format, optionally checks signatures, optionally reads an initial ram filesystem unless suppressed, records allocation and device tree preferences from flags, validates user command line duplication and termination with measurement, appends measurement and handover buffers, invokes the selected loader and cleans temporary state on any failure.

Allocation establishes debug and file mode markers, sets crash specific control state when requested, runs preparation and segment sanity, reserves control and conditionally swap pages, and unwinds through ordered release paths on failure.

Integrity recording hashes retained segments content followed by zero fill to full resident extent, stores destination ranges alongside, publishes both region list and final digest into purgatory, omits purgatory itself plus measurement and hotplug excluded entries, and may skip per entry hashing for non crash images when handover storage is active or every destination is in movable memory, doing nothing when purgatory support is absent.
Measurement segment exclusion is configuration dependent, matching a recorded index when that feature is present and never matching otherwise.
Symbol transfer insists on locating the name, exact agreement between expected and declared sizes, and placement outside uninitialized sections.
Image installation holds a global try lock for its whole duration, refusing with busy status when already held and always releasing before return including unload and error paths.
Image description object aggregates a pointer to raw input bytes, a pointer to the decoded header, and a pointer to an allocated array of decoded program entries.
Staging request aggregates source location, file backed length, resident length, alignment preference, preferred placement and a destination field completed by the staging helper.
Digest staging aggregates a fixed length hash accumulator result and an array of destination range records each pairing a base with a length.
Probe advances from header decode through program table decode to executable kind and interpreter screening and finally processor compatibility, with any rejection discarding temporary state.

Installation advances through authorization and flag screening, serialization, destination choice, allocation and content preparation, machine readiness, diagnostic copy, integrity capture, per extent staging, list termination, post handling, temporary release and atomic publication with protection of crash reserves.
Header and segment offsets combined with lengths are checked for wrap around and for exceeding available input before dereference, preventing out of bounds parsing.
Failure to reserve header storage or to decode an entry triggers release of any partial allocation and clearing of references, avoiding leaks and dangling use.
User supplied command line is duplicated with failure propagation and must end with a terminator, otherwise preparation aborts and cleans up.
Upper bound for kernel and ram filesystem payloads read from descriptors is the smaller of four gibibytes and the largest positive signed size value.
Default load path reports absence when no handler or load method is selected, otherwise forwards stored kernel, ram filesystem and command line extents to the selected handler.
Handover population fallback performs no action and reports success when the corresponding capability is unavailable.
Post load handling invokes a measurement hook for non crash images when that option is enabled, then always invokes the machine specific completion step and propagates its result.
Diagnostic output from this file carries a module derived prefix applied uniformly to formatting calls.
